methodology.answerEvidenceSupportAccuracy: All required gold facts occur verbatim in the passages retrieved for a case; this does not score a generated model answer.
methodology.citationPrecision: Retrieved source IDs matching expected evidence divided by all retrieved source IDs.
methodology.retrievalRecallAt5: Expected source IDs retrieved in the top five divided by all expected source IDs.

limitations: The benchmark uses four synthetic contract questions and is not representative of legal document distributions.
The benchmark measures retrieval evidence and source selection, not Gemini factuality, hallucination rate, or human-rated answer quality.
Re-run npm run evaluate after changing retrieval behavior; update this report only from the emitted test metrics.
